نندرج (form VII)
# نَنْدَرِجُ (nandariju) /nan.da.ri.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَرَجَ (indaraja)
# نَنْدَرِجَ (nandarija) /nan.da.ri.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَرَجَ (indaraja)
# نَنْدَرِجْ (nandarij) /nan.da.rid͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَرَجَ (indaraja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
